adjudication.rationale: The handler first gates the entire endpoint on `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` (apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts:17-20). That constant is defined as `process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET && process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY` (packages/lib/constants.ts), which is falsy when the secret is `undefined` or `""`. Therefore, if the secret is unset or empty (as in .env.example), the endpoint returns 403 before reaching the header comparison, so the described `undefined === undefined` / empty-header bypass cannot occur based on this diff.
